q.g: To begin, you need to have the Tarcone Director's office key. If you do not have one, you can find it within drawers or from Scavs. It can also be bartered for with Therapist. Once you have obtained one, head to Customs. The first place you want to visit is the red Paradigm warehouse on the east side of the map. The office is found at the top of the metal stairs. After unlocking the door there will be two rooms. The second room is the one containing the documents. Be warned though, to enter this room the door must be breached, which will create a lot of noise. After entering the room, go to the desk and look just under the table top, on top of the drawers. Leaning may help you to see it. Extract from Customs.
